regimeSub: Post-Jackson Hole Warsh speech digestion as markets await Friday PCE with stagflation backdrop intact.
themes: Fed Chair Warsh Jackson Hole debut (Aug 24-25) likely delivered hawkish hold message → rates pinned at 3.63% with 3.3% CPI overshoot; no Fed speakers ±2 days leaves markets parsing weekend remarks ahead of Friday PCE

US stagflation data stack unchanged: Q2 GDP 1.5% miss (Jul 30 WSJ), July NFP -23k (Aug 7 CNBC), July retail sales worst drop in year (Aug 14 Census) → consumer cracking while inflation stays sticky above Fed's 2% target

BOK rate decision Thursday (Aug 27) knife-edge call per Korea Herald/Korea Times Aug 25 → Governor Shin faces record household debt vs inflation; won at 1383 eases FX pressure slightly from Aug 24 levels
Nvidia earnings loom (Aug 26-27) as SOX faces sternest test per Reuters Aug 25 → $350bn implied move; SK Hynix/Samsung HBM leadership tested after July KOSPI chip rout
